procedure: two blind agent reviewers (fresh contexts, different model families) + adjudicator/final approver (project owner); not a human double review
reviewer_models: recorded outside the repository (repository files carry no vendor attribution); reviewer A is a smaller-tier model and reviewer B a larger-tier model of the same vendor

tool_call_audit.method: reviewer transcripts scanned for every tool call

reviewer_B.writes: reviewerB/part1-4 (Write x4, Edit x1) and one read-only validation script

reviewer_process_limits: Reviewer A recorded decisions as index sets in one script and wrote default non_personal/P4 for every item not listed; its evidence field is a mechanical window around the span, not a written rationale.
Reviewer B wrote per-item evidence; evidence strings are verbatim sentence substrings for both (validated).
Agreement between the two reviewers is not evidence of correctness.
